method: HTTP byte range from the verified local member-data offset through the declared compressed-member end, piped into a memory-bounded raw-deflate scanner that retained only pre-registered source package-version candidates.
cleanup: The incomplete zero-row output and stale partial diagnostics were removed. No partial relation rows were retained or used.
interpretation: The official monolithic relation member is not operationally stream-acquirable within the bounded sandbox transfer window. This does not impugn the dataset; it prevents its current use for transitive historical graph reconstruction in this project.
nextDataGate: Use an approved bulk-compute environment, an upstream filtered export, or a server-side package-filtered query before attempting interval-row extraction again.
